Claude Code.label: Outside the plugin
Claude Code.explain: What Claude Code and Brian's settings own.

Rule.label: Routing rules
Rule.explain: What the plugin decides for each subagent.

Signal.label: Feedback records
Signal.explain: What is recorded about routed runs and read back to improve the rules.

nodes.label: Tier
nodes.explain: The router's grade for a task: easy, normal, hard or long, each tied to a model (Haiku 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Opus 5.5, Fable 5.1). Source: README.md:17. Code: hooks/lib/pricing.ts:22.

nodes.label: Effort cap
nodes.explain: The most reasoning effort a tier's requests may ask for; it only ever lowers effort. Easy low (medium over about 50k tokens), normal medium, hard high, long unchanged. Source: README.md:19. Code: hooks/lib/pricing.ts:53.

nodes.label: Role
nodes.explain: A router agent kind (architect, builder, runner, fixer) or the judge group, each with a lowest and highest tier. Source: README.md:26. Code: hooks/lib/pricing.ts:180.

nodes.label: Judging agent
nodes.explain: An agent whose output is a plan, a review or an answer someone relies on, so a wrong result is silent. It never runs on Haiku, whoever installed it. Source: README.md:32. Code: hooks/lib/pricing.ts:196.

nodes.label: Risk floor
nodes.explain: A task whose agent will do lasting harm (deploy to prod, delete real data, force-push) runs on Opus or higher. Source: README.md:27. Code: hooks/lib/pricing.ts:275.

nodes.label: Pressure
nodes.explain: The rules that push routing one or two tiers cheaper: rate limit, pace and budget, each held above a floor for builders, fixers and judging agents. Source: README.md:28. Code: hooks/lib/pricing.ts:245.

nodes.label: Classifier verdict
nodes.explain: Haiku 5.5's reading of a task as a tier and a risk flag, cached by task key. Source: README.md:35. Code: hooks/lib/pricing.ts:396.

nodes.label: Rescue
nodes.explain: A stuck Haiku or Sonnet agent (3 failed tool calls in a row, or far too many requests or minutes) moves up one model mid-run. Source: README.md:29. Code: hooks/register.tsx:264.

nodes.label: Subagent
nodes.explain: A helper session Claude Code starts for one task; the only thing the router can route. Source: README.md:77. Not implemented here.

nodes.label: Main conversation
nodes.explain: The session Brian types into. A plugin cannot change its model or effort (open question Q4 checks the unread part of the docs). Source: docs/planning/research-routing-best-practices.md:55. Not implemented here.

nodes.label: Main-model lever
nodes.explain: The two settings that do set the main model: the model default in ~/.claude/settings.json (sonnet) and /model or /effort. Source: README.md:77. Not implemented here.

nodes.label: Daily report
nodes.explain: One row per subagent run and per main-conversation session, with tier and outcome, plus a short summary, written daily to ~/projects/data/logs/router. Source: docs/planning/evidence/router-report-2026-11-05.md:1. Code: /home/brian/code2/workspace/scripts/router_report.py:425.

nodes.label: Main-conversation line
nodes.explain: The report line giving main-conversation spend, the Opus share and what the same Opus tokens would cost on Sonnet, worked out as tokens times the price table. Source: docs/planning/evidence/router-report-2026-11-05.md:6. Code: /home/brian/code2/workspace/scripts/router_report.py:358.

nodes.label: Outcome signal
nodes.explain: The label on a routed run: ok, failed_tools, rescued, redone or fixed_after. It catches loud failure only. Source: README.md:89. Code: /home/brian/code2/workspace/scripts/router_report.py:309.

nodes.label: Redo
nodes.explain: A stronger model repeating a run with identical task text; a planned 'round N' with different text is not one. Source: docs/planning/evidence/router-report-2026-11-05.md:23. Code: /home/brian/code2/workspace/scripts/router_report.py:277.

nodes.label: Weekly review
nodes.explain: A Monday 07:50 job that groups outcomes by agent type and tier and proposes tier-rule changes. Source: README.md:89. Code: /home/brian/code2/workspace/scripts/router_review.py:113.

nodes.label: Tier decision
nodes.explain: A proposed change to a tier rule with its evidence, the traces to read and a status; a session accepts or rejects it and records which. Source: docs/planning/evidence/router-weekly-review-sample.md:34. Code: /home/brian/code2/workspace/scripts/router_review.py:63.
